- If sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to underpredict; adjust forecast upward by 1–2% of recent mean.
- If sentiment is strongly negative (≤ 0.33) in recent days, model tends to overpredict; adjust forecast downward by 1–2% of recent mean.
- After a sharp spike in price (true outcome > 85), model often overshoots and fails to correct; reduce forecast by 3–5% in next 3–5 days.
- If true outcome shows strong mean reversion (e.g., 3–5 consecutive days below 80), model often holds too high; reduce forecast by 2–4% per day.
- For 30-day horizon, model consistently underestimates true price when sentiment is volatile (alternating ±0.33+); apply a 1–3% upward bias to compensate.
- If sentiment history shows a recent reversal (e.g., from +0.67 to -0.33), model often fails to adjust; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 2–3 days.
